object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G58 (D-G29), Q-G14. A file held by antivirus or a running program can leave two releases in one install folder. Should, because the installer can check first but can't make the copy all-or-nothing; the remaining risk is accepted (decided on 2026-11-11), and MELLON-GUI-SRS-204 would find it.
object.description: If the Windows installer can't replace an installed file, the Windows installer should leave each installed file as the file was.
